name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Since established in 1997, we are always receiving challenge from market positively, and introducing new kinds of product for satisfying all levels of consumers from ordinary to the very high-grade, in order to make our commodities develop in the process of varieties and specification series. .



Being on the basis of humanist, we condense one team of pursuing to be remarkable, daring to innovate, having plentiful experience for technology and consummate management. Additionally, Bigeer Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd applies advanced facilities and production process, chooses high-quality ABS multiple plate material and high performance components to be raw materials, brings modernized management model into effect scientifically, and implements quality assurance system of ISO 9001, promoting the brand of Bigeer to be excellent and extraordinary situation counterparts.
